nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Financial assistance for serious illnesses
Type: Public Healthcare Service
Details: Financial assistance framework for eligible patients from poor families with specified life-threatening diseases, subject to current guidelines and fund availability.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Poor patients meeting income and treatment conditions in current RAN guidelines; covered institutions, diseases and exclusions must be checked.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Income/poverty proof, medical certificate and estimate from treating government hospital, identity and prescribed forms; additional items may apply.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Follow the prescribed process through the treating government hospital and relevant Ministry of Health and Family Welfare channel.
Official Portal: https://mohfw.gov.in/
